title: Duties of the Clans

questions.question: Which age group of Levites was counted for the work in the tent of meeting?
options: From thirty years old up to fifty years old
questions.correctAnswer: From thirty years old up to fifty years old
questions.explanation: Numbers 4:3 (ESV): "From thirty years old up to fifty years old, all who can come on duty, to do the work in the tent of meeting."

questions.question: Who was responsible for covering the holy objects before transport?
questions.explanation: Numbers 4:5 (ESV): "Aaron and his sons shall go in and take down the veil... and cover the ark..."

questions.question: What happened if the Kohathites touched the holy things directly?
questions.explanation: Numbers 4:15 (ESV): "But they must not touch the holy things, lest they die."

questions.question: What color cloth was spread over the Ark of the Testimony?
questions.explanation: Numbers 4:6 (ESV): "And spread a cloth of all blue over it."

questions.question: Which clan carried the most holy things (ark, table, etc.)?
questions.explanation: Numbers 4:4 (ESV): "The service of the sons of Kohath... is the most holy things."

questions.question: What cloth was used for the altar of burnt offering?
questions.explanation: Numbers 4:13 (ESV): "They shall take away the ashes from the altar and spread a purple cloth over it."

questions.question: What cloth was used for the table of showbread?
questions.explanation: Numbers 4:7-8: Blue cloth first, then scarlet cloth over the utensils.

questions.question: Who supervised the Eleazar son of Aaron?
options: The oil, incense, grain offering, and anointing oil
questions.correctAnswer: The oil, incense, grain offering, and anointing oil
questions.explanation: Numbers 4:16 (ESV): "And Eleazar... shall have charge of the oil for the light, the fragrant incense, the regular grain offering, and the anointing oil..."

questions.question: Who supervised the Merarites and Gershonites?
questions.explanation: Numbers 4:28, 33 (ESV): "Under the direction of Ithamar the son of Aaron the priest."

questions.question: How many men were numbered in total for the service (30-50 years old)?
What was the penalty for looking at the holy things even for a moment?
questions.explanation: Numbers 4:20 (ESV): "But they shall not go in to look on the holy things even for a moment, lest they die."

questions.question: What covered the blue cloth on the Ark?
questions.explanation: Numbers 4:6 (ESV): "Then they shall put on it a covering of goatskin..."

questions.question: What cloth covered the lampstand?
questions.explanation: Numbers 4:9 (ESV): "And they shall take a blue cloth and cover the lampstand..."

questions.question: Which group carried the heavy frames and bases using wagons (implied from ch 7)?
questions.explanation: Numbers 4:31-32 describes their load (frames, pillars, bases).

questions.question: Why did Kohath not get wagons?
options: Because the service of the holy things belonged to them; they were to carry them on their shoulders
questions.correctAnswer: Because the service of the holy things belonged to them; they were to carry them on their shoulders
questions.explanation: Numbers 7:9 (referenced here for context of their duty) states this reason.

key_verse_text: And when Aaron and his sons have finished covering the sanctuary... the sons of Kohath shall come to carry these, but they must not touch the holy things, lest they die.
